step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be the core of an analog bias circuit or a differential pair used to facilitate a constant slew rate in an Ethernet line driver. It consists of a differential pair (XM1, XM2) with an additional transistor (XM3) that likely acts as a capacitor or dummy load.

paper_reference.title: A Constant Slew Rate Ethernet Line Driver

t_rise.description: Rise time of the output signal

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the load capacitance and pull-up resistance/current. Assuming a 10k load and parasitic capacitance, rise time should be in the nanosecond range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled for SKY130 1.8V with an assumed 10k pull-up resistor.

t_fall.description: Fall time of the output signal

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the tail current discharging the output node. With 100uA tail current and small parasitic capacitance, fall time will be fast.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the tail current and load capacitance in the testbench.

slew_rate.description: Rate of change of the output voltage

sky130_expected.calculation: dV/dt during transitions. For a 1V swing in 2ns, SR = 500 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Derived from expected rise/fall times and voltage swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With 100uA tail current and 1.8V supply, P = 180uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the testbench bias conditions.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure rise time, fall time, slew rate, and power consumption of the differential pair bias circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Constant Slew Rate Ethernet Line Driver Bias Circuit Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameters
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 VDD N3 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N0 N2 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 N0 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Sources and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN N3 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2n 0.1n 0.1n 10n 20n)
VBIAS N2 0 0.9

* Tail current and Load
I_TAIL N1 0 100u
R_LOAD VDD N0 10k
C_LOAD N0 0 50f

* Analysis
.control
  * Operating Point for Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * Transient Analysis for Timing
  tran 10p 30n
  
  * The output N0 swings between approx 0.8V (when XM2 is ON) and 1.8V (when XM2 is OFF)
  * 10% to 90% of this 1V swing is 0.9V to 1.7V
  meas tran t_rise trig v(N0) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=1.7 rise=1
  meas tran t_fall trig v(N0) val=1.7 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=0.9 fall=1
  
  * Calculate Slew Rate (V/us) = dV / dt = 0.8V / t_rise|fall * 1e-6
  let dv = 0.8
  meas tran sr_rise param dv/t_rise * 1e-6
  meas tran sr_fall param dv/t_fall * 1e-6
  
  print t_rise t_fall sr_rise sr_fall
  quit
.endc
.end
